description: This Java source file defines a custom assertion class 'PolicyAssert' for unit testing 'Policy' objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to verify various properties of 'Policy' instances, such as identifiers, labels, subjects, resources, lifecycle states, revisions, and modification timestamps, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: PolicyAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class extending AssertJ's AbstractAssert for verifying properties of Policy objects in tests.

methods.name: hasId
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy's identifier matches the expected PolicyId.

methods.name: hasNamespace
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy's namespace equals the expected string.

methods.name: hasLabel
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy contains a specific label.

methods.name: doesNotHaveLabel
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy does not contain a specific label.

methods.name: hasSubjectFor
methods.description: Verifies that the Policy's entry for a given label contains a subject with the specified SubjectId.

methods.name: doesNotHaveSubjectFor
methods.description: Verifies that the Policy's entry for a given label does not contain a subject with the specified SubjectId.

methods.name: hasSubjectTypeFor
methods.description: Checks that a subject within a Policy entry has the expected SubjectType.

methods.name: hasResourceFor
methods.description: Verifies that a resource identified by label and resource key exists within the Policy.

methods.name: doesNotHaveResourceFor
methods.description: Verifies that a resource identified by label and resource key does not exist within the Policy.

methods.name: hasResourceEffectedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Checks that the resource's effected permissions match expected permissions.

methods.name: hasLifecycle
methods.description: Verifies that the Policy's lifecycle matches the expected lifecycle.

methods.name: hasNoLifecycle
methods.description: Verifies that the Policy does not have a lifecycle set.

methods.name: hasRevision
methods.description: Checks that the Policy's revision matches the expected revision.

methods.name: hasNoRevision
methods.description: Verifies that the Policy does not have a revision.

methods.name: hasModified
methods.description: Verifies the 'modified' timestamp matches the expected Instant.

methods.name: hasNoModified
methods.description: Verifies that the 'modified' timestamp is not set.

methods.name: isModifiedAfter
methods.description: Checks that the Policy was modified after a specific Instant.

methods.name: isNotModifiedAfter
methods.description: Checks that the Policy was modified before a specific Instant.

methods.name: isEqualEqualToButModified
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Policy's entityId and entries are equal to another Policy while their 'modified' timestamps may differ.
